titulo: Twelve Materials in One Contour, Cut to 90s Jungle
caption:
Twelve Materials in One Contour, Cut to 90s Jungle

A fingerprint, wood grain, a hurricane and lava are all drawn here with the same kind of line. They swap on the beat, up to ten times a second, so pause anywhere to catch one. A wordless exploration of contour lines and music.

Music made with ElevenLabs.

More from NAOS: link in bio.

#contourlines #junglemusic #generativeart
descripcion:
One island crosses a black screen, and its contour lines change material on the beat. The twelve skins: terrain, fingerprint, wood, water, marble, a gas giant's bands, a hurricane, a magnet's field, rice terraces, moon craters, silk folds and lava.
The swaps follow a slow dub at first and reach ten a second when the jungle comes in. A moment of silence holds them still before the island leaves.
Pause anywhere and look: all twelve are drawn with the same kind of line.
A wordless NAOS exploration of contour lines and sound.

Music made with ElevenLabs.
Every NAOS strategy and its sources: https://hardlypythonnmr.github.io/naos-site/biblioteca/

#contourlines #jungle #generativeart
alt: An island-shaped outline crosses a black screen from the lower right to the top. Inside it, white contour lines change material on the beat. The materials include terrain, a fingerprint, wood grain, water ripples, marble, a hurricane, rice terraces, moon craters and lava. The swaps start slow and speed up to a rapid run of patterns. After a moment of stillness the island leaves through the top and the screen ends empty. No text, no people.
